points: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf stated that if the US and Israel violate understandings reached with Tehran, Iran will resume appropriate measures, asserting that during the war the US realized it lacks military capacity to confront Iran and Israeli claims were baseless propaganda (Source: @yediotnews25/132235, @pkpoi/143120, @lelotsenzura/93337).

IRGC Commander Ahmad Vahidi declared that those aspiring to see Iran's surrender will take that aspiration to the grave, reflecting hardline rhetoric during funeral proceedings (Source: @asafroz/50964).

Funeral ceremonies for Ayatollah Khamenei drew dignitaries from 100 countries including heads of state from Turkmenistan, Iraq, Tajikistan, Georgia, prime ministers of Pakistan and Armenia, parliamentary speakers from Azerbaijan, Oman, Qatar, Iraq, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Bangladesh, Egypt, and representatives of Taliban, Iraqi militias, Hezbollah, Amal, and Palestinian Islamic Jihad (Source: @VahidOnline/76777, @asafroz/50959, @presstv/196815).
Notably absent were high-ranking officials from China, Russia, and Turkey despite their roles as Iranian allies, signaling potential diplomatic friction (Source: @VahidOnline/76777).
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met Iraqi President Abdul Latif Rashid in Tehran, underscoring bilateral coordination amid the leadership transition (Source: @shin_persian/7359).
Kurdistan Region President Nechirvan Barzani met with Qalibaf and attended the funeral, highlighting Kurdish-Iranian engagement (Source: @shin_persian/7357).
Indian, Omani, and Pakistani delegations participated in the funeral, reflecting regional diplomatic outreach (Source: @shin_persian/7352, @shin_persian/7353, @shin_persian/7354).

IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Muhammad Naim Jandiya, head of military security for Hamas' Shuja'iyya Battalion, in northern Gaza two days ago; he led the Nukhba squad that infiltrated Kibbutz Nahal Oz on October 7, kidnapped Captain Daniel Peretz, and held hostages Yotam Haim, Samer Al-Talalka, and Alon Shamriz in a tunnel (Source: @yediotnews25/132234).

Prime Minister Netanyahu spoke with President Trump on US Independence Day, praising the US as a guarantor of global freedom, and both agreed to meet soon in the United States (Source: @New_security8200/202217, @lelotsenzura/93336).
IDF Chief of Personnel Major General Dado Bar Kalifa led a secret delegation visit to Morocco in recent days, indicating deepening military ties (Source: @yediotnews25/132229).

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir awarded a citation to Captain Nathan John Parno, commander of the 'Bravo' battery, and other commanders of the US air defense array deployed in Israel throughout the war, praising unprecedented partnership (Source: @yediotnews25/132232).
Former Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot praised MK Yuli Edelstein for advancing a genuine draft law and national security strategy, reflecting internal political dynamics (Source: @amitsegal/62744).
Activists from the Democrats party and Tel Aviv Deputy Mayor Chen Arieli were violently attacked while operating a party booth in Hatikva Market; two suspects arrested (Source: @yediotnews25/132239).
Iranian Army Chief threatened revenge for Khamenei and all martyrs killed, escalating rhetoric against Israel (Source: @pkpoi/143126).

IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas Shuja'iyya Battalion security chief Muhammad Naim Jandiya in northern Gaza; he was responsible for holding three hostages in a tunnel and attempted to advance terror plans against Israeli forces recently (Source: @yediotnews25/132234).
Small arms fire directed at Arabs during clashes with settlers south of Nablus in the West Bank, indicating ongoing friction (Source: @lelotsenzura/93338).
IDF officers revealed in a security discussion that Iran funds goods entering Gaza; Hamas seizes these goods to strengthen its control, exposing a financial supply chain (Source: @inon_yttach/9262).
IDF forces under Southern Command remain deployed in the area according to the agreement and will continue to act to remove any immediate threat (Source: @yediotnews25/132234).
Jandiya was among prominent masked activists who participated in Hamas ceremonies ahead of hostage release deals, showing his public role (Source: @yediotnews25/132234).

sections.threat_assessment: The elimination of a senior Hamas commander in Gaza demonstrates Israel's continued intelligence-driven targeting capability despite ceasefire understandings. Iranian rhetoric from Qalibaf and Vahidi signals a low threshold for retaliation if perceived understandings are breached, while the Houthi engagement with Saudi jets indicates expanding regional proxy activity. The absence of key allies at Khamenei's funeral may reflect Iranian diplomatic isolation, potentially increasing regime insecurity and propensity for escalation. Netanyahu's upcoming meeting with Trump could shape US policy on Iran and Gaza, influencing near-term conflict dynamics.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors displayed divergent responses: Iraq and Kurdistan engaged diplomatically with Tehran, while Gulf states like Oman and Qatar sent representatives but Saudi Arabia remained absent. The Houthi-Saudi aerial confrontation suggests Yemen's conflict remains a flashpoint for Iranian-Saudi rivalry. Morocco's hosting of an Israeli military delegation signals deepening normalization. European naval posture adjustment (Charles de Gaulle departure) reflects recalibration after US-Iran understandings. Palestinian factions (Hamas, PIJ) maintain alignment with Iran, as evidenced by funeral attendance.
sections.intelligence_notes: The exposure of Iran's goods-funding mechanism for Hamas via Gaza imports reveals a tangible sanctions-evasion channel that could be targeted. The secret Israeli military visit to Morocco suggests expanding defense cooperation beyond public normalization. The funeral's attendee list provides a mapping of Iran's current diplomatic reach and notable gaps. Houthi claims of downing Saudi jets require verification but indicate improved air defense capabilities. Internal Israeli political friction over draft laws may affect military readiness. The absence of Khamenei family members besides Hadi Khamenei at the funeral warrants monitoring for succession signals.
